# whisperai-sdk — Complete LLM Reference & Integration Guide

> Comprehensive integration guide and type specification for `whisperai-sdk` (v2.0.0).
> Designed for AI coding assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity, Aider) and backend engineers.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Request Lifecycle

WhisperAI v2 operates a signed Google Cloud Storage (GCS) resumable upload pipeline:

```
+---------------+              +---------------+              +-------------------+
| WhisperClient |              | WhisperAI API |              | Google Cloud (GCS)|
+---------------+              +---------------+              +-------------------+
        |                              |                                |
        | 1. POST /auth/login (lazy)   |                                |
        |----------------------------->|                                |
        |<-----------------------------| (cookies: connect.sid)         |
        |                              |                                |
        | 2. POST /uploads/sign        |                                |
        |----------------------------->|                                |
        |<-----------------------------| (signedResumableInitUrl, id)   |
        |                              |                                |
        | 3. POST signedResumableInitUrl                                |
        |-------------------------------------------------------------->|
        |<--------------------------------------------------------------| (201, Location: sessionUrl)
        |                              |                                |
        | 4. PUT sessionUrl (chunks)                                    |
        |-------------------------------------------------------------->|
        |<--------------------------------------------------------------| (308 Resume Incomplete / 200/201)
        |                              |                                |
        | 5. POST /uploads/:id/complete|                                |
        |----------------------------->|                                |
        |<-----------------------------| (RecordingResponse, status: processing)
        |                              |                                |
        | 6. GET /recordings/status    |                                |
        |----------------------------->|                                |
        |<-----------------------------| (status: processing -> completed)
        |                              |                                |
        | 7. GET /recordings/:id       |                                |
        |----------------------------->|                                |
        |<-----------------------------| (CompletedRecordingResponse)   |
```

### Self-Healing & Resilience
- **Auth Recovery**: If any API endpoint returns HTTP 401, `recall()` automatically triggers `login()` and replays the original request. Concurrent callers share a single in-flight `loginPromise`.
- **Transient GCS Failures**: If a chunk PUT fails with network error, HTTP 408, 429, or 5xx, the SDK probes GCS with `PUT bytes */totalSize` to determine the committed offset, updates the cursor, applies exponential backoff with jitter, and resumes without restarting the entire file.
- **Upload Cancellation / Abandonment**: On terminal failure, the client notifies WhisperAI via `POST /uploads/:id/abandon` with the reason (`session-open-failed`, `put-non-retriable`, `put-retries-exhausted`) to free cloud resources.

---

## 2. Complete Type Definitions

```typescript
export type AudioInput = Uint8Array | ReadableStream<Uint8Array>

export interface ClientOptions {
  /** Credentials for WhisperAI dashboard authentication */
  login: {
    email: string
    password: string
  }
  /** API Base URL (defaults to "https://whisperai.com") */
  whisperUrl?: string
  /** Chunk size in bytes for GCS upload parts. Must be multiple of 256 KiB. Default: 8388608 (8 MiB) */
  chunkSize?: number
  /** Max retry attempts per chunk on transient network/5xx errors. Default: 8 */
  maxUploadAttempts?: number
  /** Initial retry backoff in ms. Default: 1000 */
  initialRetryDelayMs?: number
  /** Max retry backoff in ms. Default: 30000 */
  maxRetryDelayMs?: number
  /** Enable diagnostic breadcrumbs sent to WhisperAI. Default: true */
  diagnostics?: boolean
  /** Polling interval in ms for waitForTranscription. Default: 2000 (2s) */
  pollIntervalMs?: number
  /** Total timeout in ms for waitForTranscription. Default: 1800000 (30m) */
  transcriptionTimeoutMs?: number
  /** Request timeout in ms for individual HTTP and GCS calls. Default: 120000 (2m) */
  requestTimeoutMs?: number
}

export interface OperationOptions {
  /** AbortSignal to cancel in-flight uploads or polling */
  signal?: AbortSignal
  /** Upload progress callback (percentage: 0 to 100) */
  onProgress?: (percentage: number) => void
  /** Correlation ID for tracing diagnostics. Defaults to auto-generated 8-char ID */
  diagnosticId?: string
  /** Override diagnostics sending for this call */
  diagnostics?: boolean
}

export interface TranscribeOptions extends OperationOptions {
  /** Polling interval in ms. Default: 2000 */
  pollIntervalMs?: number
  /** Maximum wait duration in ms before timing out. Default: 1800000 (30m) */
  timeoutMs?: number
}

export type TranscriptionStyle = "standard" | "clean_readable" | (string & {})
export type SpeakerIdentificationMode = "role" | "name" | (string & {})

export interface InitMetaFile {
  /** Audio filename including extension (e.g. "meeting.m4a") */
  filename: string
  /** Audio duration in seconds (must be positive) */
  durationSeconds: number
  /** Optional title for the recording (defaults to filename without extension) */
  title?: string
  /** Audio MIME type (e.g. "audio/x-m4a", "audio/wav", "audio/webm") */
  mimeType?: string
  /** Total byte size. Required for ReadableStream to avoid in-memory buffering */
  totalSize?: number
  /** ISO language code or "auto" / "multi-auto". Default: "auto" */
  language?: string
  /** Enable speaker diarization. Default: false */
  enableSpeakerDetection?: boolean
  /** Number of speakers: "auto" or integer count. Default: "auto" */
  speakerCount?: "auto" | number
  /** Transcription format: "standard" or "clean_readable". Default: "standard" */
  transcriptionStyle?: TranscriptionStyle
  /** Custom vocabulary or terms to improve recognition */
  importantTerms?: string
  /** System prompt guiding transcription */
  customPrompt?: string
  /** Enable labeled speaker identification. Default: false */
  speakerIdentificationEnabled?: boolean
  /** Speaker identification mode: "role" or "name". Default: "role" */
  speakerIdentificationMode?: SpeakerIdentificationMode
  /** Predefined speaker names or roles */
  speakerIdentificationValues?: string[]
  /** Optional folder ID in WhisperAI */
  folderId?: number
}

export interface TranscriptionSegment {
  id: number
  start: number
  end: number
  text: string
}

export interface Translation {
  id: number
  transcriptionId: number
  targetLanguage: string
  content: string
  status: string
  createdAt: string
}

export interface Transcription {
  id: number
  userId: number
  recordingId: number
  content: string
  editedContent: string | null
  confidence: number
  segments: TranscriptionSegment[]
  translations: Translation[]
  timestamps: {
    words: unknown[]
    duration: number
    language: string
    segments: TranscriptionSegment[]
  }
  speakers: unknown | null
  speakerNames: Record<string, unknown>
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
  summary: unknown | null
}

export interface RecordingResponse {
  id: number
  userId: number
  title: string
  originalFilename: string
  fileExtension: string
  mimeType: string
  audioUrl: string
  duration: number
  language: string
  status: "queued" | "processing" | "completed" | "failed" | "canceled" | "retry_pending" | "retry_processing"
  speakerDetectionEnabled: boolean
  speakerCount: number | null
  totalChunks: number | null
  uploadSessionId: string
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
  transcription: Transcription | null
}

export interface CompletedRecordingResponse extends RecordingResponse {
  status: "completed"
  transcription: Transcription
}

export type FinalizeUploadResponse = RecordingResponse
```

---

## 3. Error Classes Hierarchy

```
WhisperError (abstract, has code: string, diagnosticId?: string)
├── WhisperAuthError           (code: "AUTH_ERROR") — 401 Unauthorized, invalid credentials
├── WhisperApiError            (code: "API_ERROR", status: number, response: unknown) — Non-2xx API responses
├── WhisperNetworkError        (code: "NETWORK_ERROR", cause?: unknown) — DNS / connection failure
├── WhisperUploadError         (code: "UPLOAD_ERROR", diagnosticId?: string, cause?: unknown) — GCS stream or upload failure
├── WhisperTimeoutError        (code: "TIMEOUT_ERROR", recordingId: number, timeoutMs: number) — Polling exceeded limit
└── WhisperTranscriptionError  (code: "TRANSCRIPTION_ERROR", recordingId: number, status: string) — WhisperAI failed processing
```

---

## 4. End-to-End Recipes

### Recipe A: NestJS Service Integration

```typescript
import { Injectable, OnModuleInit } from "@nestjs/common"
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config"
import { WhisperClient, CompletedRecordingResponse } from "whisperai-sdk"

@Injectable()
export class WhisperService implements OnModuleInit {
  private client!: WhisperClient

  constructor(private readonly config: ConfigService) {}

  onModuleInit() {
    this.client = new WhisperClient({
      login: {
        email: this.config.getOrThrow<string>("WHISPER_EMAIL"),
        password: this.config.getOrThrow<string>("WHISPER_PASSWORD")
      },
      chunkSize: 8 * 1024 * 1024,
      diagnostics: true
    })
  }

  async transcribeAudio(
    fileBuffer: Buffer,
    filename: string,
    durationSeconds: number,
    language = "auto"
  ): Promise<CompletedRecordingResponse> {
    return this.client.transcribe(
      new Uint8Array(fileBuffer),
      {
        filename,
        durationSeconds,
        language,
        enableSpeakerDetection: true
      },
      {
        timeoutMs: 15 * 60 * 1000 // 15 minutes
      }
    )
  }
}
```

### Recipe B: Express / Fastify Upload Endpoint

```typescript
import express from "express"
import multer from "multer"
import { WhisperClient } from "whisperai-sdk"

const app = express()
const upload = multer({ storage: multer.memoryStorage() })
const client = new WhisperClient({
  login: { email: process.env.WHISPER_EMAIL!, password: process.env.WHISPER_PASSWORD! }
})

app.post("/api/transcribe", upload.single("audio"), async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    if (!req.file) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing audio file" })
    const duration = parseFloat(req.body.durationSeconds) || 60

    const result = await client.transcribe(new Uint8Array(req.file.buffer), {
      filename: req.file.originalname,
      durationSeconds: duration,
      mimeType: req.file.mimetype
    })

    res.json({
      recordingId: result.id,
      text: result.transcription.content,
      segments: result.transcription.segments
    })
  } catch (error) {
    next(error)
  }
})
```

### Recipe C: Streaming from S3 or Remote URL

```typescript
import { WhisperClient } from "whisperai-sdk"

async function transcribeFromUrl(client: WhisperClient, audioUrl: string, durationSeconds: number) {
  const headResponse = await fetch(audioUrl, { method: "HEAD" })
  const contentLength = Number(headResponse.headers.get("content-length"))

  const audioResponse = await fetch(audioUrl)
  if (!audioResponse.body) throw new Error("No response body")

  return client.transcribe(audioResponse.body, {
    filename: "downloaded.mp3",
    durationSeconds,
    totalSize: contentLength, // Prevents in-memory buffering!
    mimeType: headResponse.headers.get("content-type") ?? "audio/mpeg"
  })
}
```

### Recipe D: Background Worker with Status Tracking

```typescript
import { WhisperClient, WhisperStatus } from "whisperai-sdk"

// Step 1: Upload worker job
async function startUploadJob(client: WhisperClient, audio: Uint8Array, filename: string, duration: number) {
  const started = await client.startTranscription(audio, {
    filename,
    durationSeconds: duration
  })
  return started.id // Store in your database with status = "processing"
}

// Step 2: Scheduled polling cron / job
async function pollPendingRecordings(client: WhisperClient, pendingIds: number[]) {
  if (pendingIds.length === 0) return

  const statuses = await client.recordingStatus(pendingIds)
  for (const item of statuses) {
    if (item.recordingStatus === WhisperStatus.COMPLETED) {
      const recording = await client.recording(item.recordingId)
      console.log(`Recording ${item.recordingId} completed:`, recording.transcription?.content)
    } else if (item.recordingStatus === WhisperStatus.FAILED) {
      console.error(`Recording ${item.recordingId} failed`)
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 5. Diagnostics & Troubleshooting

- **Upload Diagnostics**: If `diagnostics: true` (default), the client sends diagnostic breadcrumbs to `/api/v2/diagnostics/upload-breadcrumb`. Each operation gets an 8-character hex correlation ID (`context.diagnosticId`). If an upload fails, `WhisperUploadError.diagnosticId` contains this correlation ID to match logs with WhisperAI support.
- **Budget Guard**: When testing in CI/CD, always inspect `client.usage()`:
  ```typescript
  const usage = await client.usage()
  const remainingMinutes = usage.limits.monthlyMinutes - usage.monthlyUsageMinutes
  if (remainingMinutes < 3) {
    throw new Error("Insufficient monthly WhisperAI minutes for test")
  }
  ```
